log.msg: cause 1: styles/layouts/word.js's word() factory took a config key named `words` (a class string, e.g. "flex gap") and spread it onto a new Page() via Object.assign. Page.class.js added its OWN `words()` naming-pipeline method later (git: 8d18080, after word.js's `words:` key, 8d37317) - assigning the string over the method makes naming() call this.words() on a string. Only flex/page.js and grid/page.js use word({ words: ... }); the other 5 erroring pages (split, document, overlay, landing, bold-editorial) just embed flex/grid as siblings/related pages and inherit the crash secondhand. Fix: renamed the key words -> string throughout word.js, flex/page.js, grid/page.js - no core file touched.

cause 2: ux/Auth/page.js was the ONLY one of 24 demo.exhibit() callers that omitted `page:` (on purpose, per its own comment, to dodge a real second bug: Doc's derived Overview/API/Docs/Files sections are page.children too, so exhibit's Variants wall drew them alongside the real variant). Omitting page crashed page.demo() instead. Fixed both: exhibit.js's variants() now subtracts page.constructor.SECTIONS (the same list Doc.wall() already uses) before drawing the wall, and added a guard that throws a clear one-line error if page is ever missing again; Auth/page.js now passes page: this like every sibling.

assign.outcome:
**Both pre-existing console errors are gone, fixed at the cause — not patched per page.**

**1. `this.words is not a function`** — `styles/layouts/word.js`'s `word()` factory used a config key named `words` (a class string like `"flex gap"`). `Page.class.js` later added its own `words()` naming-pipeline method, and `Object.assign`-ing that string over the method broke `naming()` for every page `word()` built. Renamed the key `words` → `string` in `word.js`, `flex/page.js`, `grid/page.js` — no core file touched. It only threw from `flex/`/`grid/` themselves, but the site's shared nav constructs them eagerly, so the crash reached nearly every page under `styles/layouts/`.

**2. `ux/Auth/`'s crash** — it was the only one of 24 `demo.exhibit()` callers to omit `page:`, on purpose, to dodge a real second bug: a `Doc`'s derived Overview/API/Docs/Files tabs are `page.children` too, so exhibit's "Variants" wall drew them alongside the real variant. Fixed at the cause in `ext/demo/exhibit.js`: `variants()` now subtracts `page.constructor.SECTIONS` (the same list `Doc.wall()` already uses) before drawing the wall, plus a guard that throws one clear line if `page` is ever missing again. `ux/Auth/page.js` now passes `page: this` like every sibling — and its Variants section is *more* correct than before the crash: just the real `magic-auth` card, no chrome mixed in.

**Proof.** Backed up the 5 changed files, restored git HEAD, crawled every `page.js` under `styles/layouts/` (38) and `ux/` (9) at 1280+3440 = 98 loads: 80 bad, 40 distinct erroring urls. Restored the fixes, same 98-load crawl: 0 errors. Screenshots confirm both fixed pages render their real content.

**Files changed:** `public/framework/styles/layouts/word.js`, `public/framework/styles/layouts/flex/page.js`, `public/framework/styles/layouts/grid/page.js`, `public/framework/ext/demo/exhibit.js`, `public/framework/ux/Auth/page.js`.

**Left alone:** the systemic "Doc chrome mixed into Variants" bug is now fixed generically for every `Doc`-based `demo.exhibit()` caller (Tags, Filter, Course, Menu, Pagination, Tree too) as a side effect — not verified visually on all of them, only Auth.
